questions.q: Which describes the image in a plane mirror?
questions.why: A plane-mirror image is virtual (cannot be formed on a screen), the same size and laterally inverted.

questions.q: A ray in glass hits the glass–air boundary at an angle of incidence greater than the critical angle. What happens?
options: it refracts away from the normal
questions.why: Above the critical angle all the light is totally internally reflected (as in optical fibres).

questions.q: Which list is in order of increasing wavelength?
questions.why: Wavelength increases from gamma through X-rays, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwaves to radio.

questions.q: A ray of light enters a glass block with an angle of incidence of 40°. The angle of refraction is 25°. Calculate the refractive index of the glass.
